output.reason: The only prose evidence is one changelog line saying IPWhiteList was renamed to IPAllowList [ev-a714bf0cb614]. It doesn't say whether the old name is still accepted, deprecated or rejected, so it doesn't tell us what happens to an operator who does nothing. The CRD schema check contradicts a simple rename: spec.ipWhiteList is in the traefik.io Middleware schema in both v2.11.2 and v3.0.0, and no version drops it while gaining spec.ipAllowList [ev-4fd00a8d9fd6, ev-0842f8f3bd9d]. To write the consequence, we need the migration guide or PR #9457 to say how the old name behaves in v3.0.0.
